provenance.status: 8 of 37 clauses human-labelled by yosef (1.1, 2, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, 5.2); the remaining 29 are null and excluded from scoring. All 8 are `ok`, so this subset can only detect false positives — an analyzer that never flags anything scores 100% against it, and no change can make it fail downward. The discriminating clauses (12.2 daily penalty, 13.x breach, 14.1 security) are still unlabelled; the subset is not a precision/recall measurement until they are.
provenance.note: rental-02 is a Hebrew lease template that Yosef populated by hand on 2026-09-09: term, dates, rent and the daily late-vacate rate now carry real values, and the preamble carries real party details. It is a filled template, not a signed executed lease — the labels judge the clauses as written with the values Yosef chose. Placeholder runs are down from 27 to 4; the only analysis unit still carrying one is 16.1 (signature lines). Filling changed no clause boundaries: extraction still yields 52 clauses / 37 analysis units with byte-identical ids, so the annotation keys below remained valid across the edit. Empty fields, where any remain, are NULL and never a defect — enforced in ANALYZER_SYSTEM rule 9 (agents/prompts.py); not yet verified live. Caveats for the annotator: (1) the source numbers two consecutive clauses '6.2', disambiguated positionally by document order into 6.2-1 and 6.2-2 — those suffixes are content-independent, so any future normalize/chunking change could swap them and silently re-point labels; re-verify the pair if the extractor changes. (2) 6.2-1's body is a stub ('payments as follows:'); the breakdown is absent from the extracted text, cause unconfirmed. (3) 16.1 is a MERGED unit: the extractor swept the trailing signature block into the same chunk as the addresses provision, so one row carries two unrelated things — a substantive clause about where notice is served, and a signature area. Both remaining placeholder runs belong to the signature half. Anchor the label on the addresses provision; the signature block is not a judgeable term.
